messages.subject: Change iterations
parts:
An SEM I'm running says it ends normally after 423 iterations. Is there a way I can set the number of iterations in R? I'm comparing my results to MPlus, in which I used 15000 iterations. The only thing I could find about setting iterations in R is to set the maximum number of iterations using control=list(iter.max= . I've tried setting the maximum number of iterations to different numbers, but it always ends after 423. Any help would be appreciated!

Anna

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: Change iterations
parts: > I've tried setting the maximum number of iterations to different numbers

As the name of the argument implies, it controls the maximum number of iterations. If convergence was achieved after 423 iterations, then even if you set the maximum number of iterations to any number higher than 423, it will always stop after 423 iterations if the starting values are the same and no stochastic perturbation is involved in the optimization.
> I'm comparing my results to MPlus, in which I used 15000 iterations

I am not familiar with Mplus. Did you mean Mplus achieved convergence after 15000 iterations? Or did you force Mplus to do 15000 iterations? Or did you mean you set the maximum number of iterations to 15000 in Mplus?

-- Shu Fai
